title: 第45章 各人有个人的命

第45章 各人有个人的命-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

后来林美丽被打得头破血流跑回娘家的时候，他冲出去找王超算账。

王超家那五间大瓦房，他踹开大门冲进去，一拳打掉了王超两颗门牙。

王超的爹，那个农机厂主任报了警，他在派出所蹲了一晚上。

赵素梅带着两个女儿在派出所门口等了一夜，哭了一夜。

这些都是上辈子的事，林美丽不知道。

这辈子，他不想让林美丽嫁过去。

他尽到作为哥哥的责任，几次三番提醒。

但她不听。

他还能怎么样？

烟烧到了手指，烫得他“嘶”了一声，赶紧扔掉。

他站起来，拍了拍裤腿上的土，重新骑上车。

回到店里的时候，赵素梅正在灶台边忙活。

赵志军在前面招呼客人，看见他进来，喊了一声“三姐夫”，又转头去端盘子了。

赵素梅看了他一眼，没说话，把一碗面递给他。

“吃了没？”

“没。”

“那先吃面。”

林国强接过碗，坐在角落里的桌子前，低头吃面。

面是酸菜肉丝面，酸菜是他自己腌的，脆生生的，酸中带辣，开胃得很。

他吃了几口，忽然觉得没胃口，放下筷子。

赵素梅走过来，在他对面坐下。

“咋了？”

“没咋。”

“美丽的事？”

林国强沉默了一会儿，点了点头。

“他们让你出多少？”

“家具，全套的。”

赵素梅的脸色变了一下，但很快恢复了正常：“你答应了？”

“没有。”林国强摇了摇头，“我说家具我不出。

要是想打家具，让三家平分出钱，大哥和老三不出，我也不出。”

赵素梅愣了一下，然后低下头，嘴角微微翘了一下。

“那你准备出什么？”

“两床棉被，十块礼金。”

赵素梅抬起头，看着他的眼睛。

他的眼睛里有疲惫，有无奈，但更多的是一种说不清道不明的坚定。

“国强，”她轻声说，“你做得对。”

林国强看着她，忽然觉得心里那团火烧得不那么旺了。

赵素梅的眼神像一瓢水，浇在上面，没那么烫了，但还是温热的。

“你不觉得我对自己亲妹子抠门？”他问。

Later, when Lin Meili was beaten badly and ran back to her parents' home, he rushed out to find Wang Chao to settle the score.

He kicked open the door of Wang Chao's five large tile-roofed houses, rushed in, and knocked out Wang Chao's two front teeth with one punch.

Wang Chao's father, the director of the agricultural machinery factory, called the police, and he stayed at the police station all night.

Zhao Sumei and her two daughters waited at the door of the police station all night and cried all night.

These were all things in the previous life, Lin Meili didn't know.

In this life, he doesn't want Lin Meili to marry.

He fulfilled his responsibility as an older brother and reminded him several times.

But she didn't listen.

What else could he do?

The smoke burned his fingers, causing him to hiss and throw them away quickly.

He stood up, patted the dirt on his trouser legs, and got back on the bike.

When she returned to the store, Zhao Sumei was busy working on the stove.

Zhao Zhijun was greeting the guests in front. When he saw him coming in, he called out "Third Brother-in-law" and turned to serve the dishes.

Zhao Sumei glanced at him, said nothing, and handed him a bowl of noodles.

"Have you eaten?"

"No."

"Then eat noodles first."

Lin Guoqiang took the bowl, sat at the table in the corner, and ate the noodles with his head down.

The noodles are shredded pork noodles with sauerkraut. The sauerkraut is pickled by himself. It is crispy, sour and spicy, and very appetizing.

After taking a few bites, he suddenly felt no appetite and put down his chopsticks.

Zhao Sumei came over and sat down opposite him.

"What's wrong?"

"Nothing."

"Beautiful thing?"

Lin Guoqiang was silent for a while and nodded.

"How much did they ask you to pay?"

"Furniture, complete."

Zhao Sumei's expression changed for a moment, but she quickly returned to normal: "You agreed?"

"No." Lin Guoqiang shook his head, "I said I wouldn't sell the furniture.

If you want to buy furniture, let the three families share the money equally. If the eldest brother and the third child don't contribute, neither will I."

Zhao Sumei was stunned for a moment, then lowered her head and raised the corners of her mouth slightly.

"Then what are you going to do?"

"Two quilts, ten yuan gift."

Zhao Sumei raised her head and looked into his eyes.

There was fatigue and helplessness in his eyes, but more importantly, there was an indescribable determination.

"Guoqiang," she said softly, "you did the right thing."

Lin Guoqiang looked at her and suddenly felt that the fire in his heart was no longer so strong.

Zhao Sumei's eyes were like a ladle of water poured on it. It was no longer so hot, but still warm.

"Don't you think I'm stingy with my own sister?" he asked.
